title: Goats and Tigers | BaghChal
desc: Play the classic traditional Bagh-Chal (Tiger and Goat) board game offline! Features authentic rules, 3 board styles, sound effects, and pass-and-play 2 player mode.
releaseNotes: Initial Release (v1.0.1): - Authentic traditional Bagh-Chal rules and jump-capture mechanics. - Support for 3 board styles: Classic 5x5, Trapezoid, and Triangle. - Pass & Play 2-Player offline mode. - Interactive move hints and crisp sound effects. - Clean, responsive UI with Undo and Restart support.

title: OX ARENA
desc: OX ARENA: A fast tactical Tic-Tac-Toe duel. Play offline 2-player on one device, duel friends online using private room codes, or compete globally in real-time.
releaseNotes: v1.0.2 Initial Launch: • Offline 2-Player local pass & play mode • Real-time Private Room multiplayer using invite codes • Global Matchmaking to challenge players worldwide • Interactive procedural sound effects and audio toggle • Modern dark cyber-neon tactical HUD interface • Optimized for smooth low-latency mobile gameplay

title: Neon Dash

releaseNotes: Version 1.0.3 (Initial Release): • Full offline gameplay support (Bina internet ke chalne wala) • Smooth one-touch intuitive controls • Futuristic neon graphics aur dynamic visual effects • Interactive home screen dashboard aur custom neon themes • Built-in synthesizer sound effects

title: Zappora Store

title: Deca chat
desc: Fast, private, and secure group chat app. Create or join custom rooms with a simple room code and connect with up to 20 members without passwords or sign-ups.
releaseNotes: • Initial release (v1.0.1) with real-time messaging and image sharing. • Instant room access with random 6-character room codes (no PIN/passwords needed). • Customizable member limits per room (up to 20 members). • Privacy Shield protection with anti-screenshot blur support. • Quick room renaming and localized device customization.
